import networkx as nx

edges = [(5,13), (8,15), (1,4), (0,4), (8,10), (0,15), (3,10), (7,12), (10,15), (3,7), (4,5), (2,9), (0,9), (3,15), (0,10), (6,9), (3,5), (3,4), (1,14), (6,8), (10,11), (3,14), (4,6), (7,9)]

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(16))
G.add_edges_from(edges)

# Add a cycle to ensure 2-connectivity
for i in range(16):
    G.add_edge(i, (i+1)%16)

print("Is 2-connected:", nx.node_connectivity(G) >= 2)

final_edges = sorted([tuple(sorted(e)) for e in G.edges()])
flattened = [x for e in final_edges for x in e]
print(flattened)
